value.rationale: A natural endpoint obstruction to replacing pointwise curvature control by integrability criteria: any predetermined countable list of continuous curvature-energy conditions, even all powers and all integer exponential moments, can hold on a complete, uniformly Euclidean-growth manifold with positive inj and Ricci arbitrarily small, although every Euclidean isometric immersion must have unbounded mean curvature. The countable diagonal theorem is a genuinely new quantified boundary and not merely an example of finite Lp integration.
